criteria.text: Given a MockWebServer parse response with profile.summary, profile.location, profile.links [LINKEDIN, PORTFOLIO, OTHER] and entries with current true (endDate null) and current false, When RemoteResumeTextParser parses it, Then the CandidateProfile has summary = the summary, city = the location, linkedinUrl = the first LINKEDIN url, portfolioUrl = the first PORTFOLIO url (OTHER ignored), a current entry has endDate 'Present' (the fixture convention, app-w3w4 needs_info), a non-current entry with endDate null keeps endDate '' (the device required-gap rule then asks), null summary/location map to '', every entry is IMPORTED and unconfirmed with FactIdAllocator ids, and droppedSensitive still reaches the caller.

Given a profile with a non-blank summary, When the facts payload is built for POST /analyses and POST /tailorings, Then it carries summary {id, text} with an id that matches ^[A-Za-z0-9:_.-]{1,64}$, does not start with ans-, and collides with no entry or bullet id; a blank or over-1,000-character summary is omitted; the payload never carries fullName, email, phone, headline, city or links, never a USER_ANSWER entry, never an ans- id, and userStatedSkills keeps its current rule (omitted when empty).

Given the serialized JSON bodies of POST /analyses and POST /tailorings built from a GapAnalysis that holds reasons, a job location and a question, When they are inspected in a MockWebServer test, Then no match carries a 'reason' key and the job carries no 'location' key (the server's strict matchSchema rejects reason: null, contract delta 1), 'section' is absent or null, 'answer' is absent or null when there is no answer, and no other key outside contract v2 section 3/4.4 appears.

Given a MockWebServer analysis response with job.location, a reason on each match and a question for a GAP/PARTIAL must-have, When RemoteJobAnalysisSource analyses, Then the JobAnalysisResult has job.location, each RequirementMatch.reason, and GapAnalysis.question with requirementId, text and why; given question null, Then question is null; given a question whose requirementId is not in the job or whose requirement is MET after the device evidence filter, Then question is null.

Given a server match whose status the device changes (evidence ids dropped by the sendable-facts filter, MET/PARTIAL turned GAP, or a local rematch upgrade after a profile edit), When the analysis or its cached rematch is returned, Then that match's server reason is removed (null), so a reason is never shown for a status the server did not give (I.1, D21/D23).

Given POST /analyses answers 422 NOT_A_JOB_POST, When the analysis runs, Then the caller gets AiException(AiFailure.NotAJobPost) (not InvalidInput, not Unavailable), nothing is cached for that JD, and no retry is made; and Given 429 ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED or 409 ANALYSIS_IN_PROGRESS, Then the existing AllowanceExhausted / AnalysisInProgress failures still come back with no retry.

Given an application with a QuickAnswer (choice YES_REGULARLY, A_FEW_TIMES, NOT_YET or SKIPPED) whose requirementId is in the job, When the tailoring starts, Then the request carries answer {requirementId, choice, detail} with a blank detail sent as null and a detail never over 400 characters; given no answer, an unknown choice string or a requirementId not in the job, Then answer is null (never a 400).

Given a SUCCEEDED tailoring result with summary {text, sourceIds, verification} and skills {ordered, added}, When RemoteResumeTailor maps it, Then TailoredResume.summary and TailoredResume.skills are set (original = the profile summary and profile skills) and still pass through TailorResumeUseCase; given summary null, Then summary is null (no change); given skills.ordered empty or skills missing (rows stored before apps-backend #109), Then skills is null and the profile skills are untouched (contract delta 5); given a summary citing an id the device cannot resolve, Then the guard keeps the original summary (fail closed) and a test proves it.

Given POST /tailorings answers 402 NO_CREDIT, When tailoring starts, Then the caller gets AiFailure.NoCredit, the pending requestId is cleared and no poll is made; given a job that ends FAILED with any failureCode (including INTERRUPTED or a code the app does not know), Then the caller gets a failure, the requestId is cleared so the next attempt sends a new requestId (contract 4.4 rule 5), and the bullets of the old result are never shown.

Given a network drop or the 330 s poll give-up after a 202, When tailoring is retried for the same application, Then the same requestId is sent (the server answers 200 with the same job and charges nothing more), and the request body carries no 'section'.

Given RemoteJobImporter, When import(url) is called with an https URL, Then it POSTs {url} to v1/tailormyresume/job-imports and returns jobText and sourceHost; given a non-https or over-2,048-character URL, Then it fails with AiFailure.InvalidInput and no request is sent; given 422 JOB_IMPORT_FAILED, Then AiFailure.JobImportFailed; given 429 ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED, Then AllowanceExhausted; given 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After, Then RateLimited with retryAfterSeconds and no automatic retry (contract delta 2).

Given ApiError, When the body code is NOT_A_JOB_POST or JOB_IMPORT_FAILED (422), Then apiErrorOf maps them to new ApiError.NotAJobPost and ApiError.JobImportFailed, and an unknown 422 code still maps to Unknown(422); a MockWebServer test covers every new field and every new error code (issue acceptance criterion 1).

Given the prod Hilt graph, When AiBindingsTest resolves the bindings, Then JobAnalysisSource, ResumeTailor and ResumeTextParser bind the guarded/remote prod classes and JobImporter binds RemoteJobImporter; and Given the demo graph, Then the demo bindings are unchanged (or gain only an offline JobImporter fake if the core contract lands here), and :app:assembleDemoDebug merges a manifest with no INTERNET permission.
Given the analysis and tailoring results, When they are stored by the caller, Then generationId is kept on GapAnalysis and on every TailoredBullet (contract 3 generationId, 8.1) exactly as today.

Given core/network/src/main and app/src/prod sources, When they are searched, Then there is no Log., Timber, println or HttpLoggingInterceptor, and no test or source writes a body, URL, token or answer detail to a log.

Given the branch head, When `./gradlew :app:testProdDebugUnitTest`, `./gradlew dependencyGuard` and `tools/ci/verify-local.sh` run, Then all pass and both dependencyGuard baselines are unchanged (issue acceptance criteria 2-4).

Contract v2 (docs/BACKEND_CONTRACT.md on PR #293 head revamp/285-contract-v2 00e99f41) is the shape source of truth; read it with `git show origin/revamp/285-contract-v2:docs/BACKEND_CONTRACT.md`. Where the deployed server PRs differ, follow the stricter of the two and record the delta in the PR body under Decisions (see contract_deltas in this file). Never edit docs/BACKEND_CONTRACT.md in this lane; a needed doc change is a follow-up on #285.

Requests: every request keeps X-App-Id and the Firebase bearer through the existing AppIdInterceptor/AuthInterceptor (one forced refresh on 401). Server bodies are strict: an unknown or null-for-optional field is 400 INVALID_INPUT, so tailormyresumeJson() (encodeDefaults = true, explicitNulls default) must not emit keys the server schema lacks. Responses: ignoreUnknownKeys stays on; a new or unknown enum value in a response (failureCode, verification, ledger kind, link kind, editType) must not crash decoding: decode it as nullable/unknown and fail closed (drop the item or treat as a generic failure).

Timeouts and retries: keep the existing OkHttp connect 15 s / read 60 s / call 75 s (contract 2: sync AI routes stop at 45 s on the server, app waits 60 s). No automatic retry of a sync AI call (analyses count every run; ANALYSIS_IN_PROGRESS is shown, not retried). Tailoring start keeps the bounded RATE_LIMITED retry (3 attempts, Retry-After honoured up to 60 s) and polling with backoff (2 s first, max 5 s, give up at 330 s per contract 4.4 rule 5). Background reposts stay bounded (5 tries, 2-32 s). No unbounded loop.

Privacy: never log a request or response body, resume text, JD text, job URL, fact, answer detail, purchase token, order id, uid or ID token (contract 2, 4.5 rule 4). No OkHttp logging interceptor, no Log/Timber/println in core/network or app/src/prod.

Truth (I.1): the on-device FabricationGuard via TailorResumeUseCase stays the last gate after the server checks (contract D7). The prod path must not bypass or loosen it; I.1 gate tests OfflineFabricationGuardTest and TailorResumeUseCaseTest keep every assertion. When the device cannot resolve a cited id it fails closed (the original text stays). Answer facts: only the server issues ans- ids; the app never sends USER_ANSWER entries or ans- ids (sendableFacts already filters them; keep the test).

II.6: each AI step stays behind its core:domain interface with a Hilt binding per flavour; core:network depends only on core:model (no core:domain import there); prod mapping from DTO to domain lives in app/src/prod or core:network mappers to core:model types.

IV.2/IV.3: fakes only (FakePlayBilling, FixedIds, MockWebServer); no mocking library; runTest and virtual time, no Thread.sleep. MockWebServer and Robolectric are already testProdImplementation / core:network testImplementation, so no new dependency; dependencyGuard baselines (app/dependencies/demoReleaseRuntimeClasspath.txt, prodReleaseRuntimeClasspath.txt) stay unchanged (PLAN 6.4).

Process rules: never git stash (shared stash stack across lane worktrees); worktree with `git worktree add -b <branch> <path> <base>`; no tools:ignore, no lint-baseline entries (III.3), no weakened tests; no code comments unless they pass the grounding test in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (III.2: cite the contract section line); one bounded wait per Gradle run; never ./gradlew --stop while other lanes run; host load rule D22/D35 (2 lanes when load is over about 12); stage paths explicitly (no git add -A).

Staging: backend PRs apps-backend #101-#111 are open, not deployed (merges blocked, #256). Tests run against MockWebServer only; no call to the Fly.io app from tests. A live check belongs to Phase 3 after deploy.

Issue file set plus required extras (record each in the PR under Decisions): core/network/src/main/**/ApiError.kt (two new codes), core/network/src/test/resources/contract/*.json (v2 fixtures), and, only under the shared-contract default, core/model GapAnalysis.kt/JobDescription.kt/new QuickQuestion.kt, core/domain AiFailure.kt, ResumeTailor.kt, new JobImporter.kt, offline/OfflineResumeTailor.kt, TailorResumeUseCase.kt (call site only) and app/src/prod ai/GuardedResumeTailor.kt. Every core addition is additive with a default value so existing callers compile; enum additions to AiFailure need no exhaustive-when change outside AiFailureMapping (only prod maps it today).

Request DTO hazard (contract delta 1): with encodeDefaults = true a nullable `reason` or `location` default would be sent as null and the server answers 400. Requests must omit them. Tests assert on the raw request JSON.

Answer mapping: QuickAnswer.choice is a String holding enum names (D38: YES_REGULARLY, A_FEW_TIMES, NOT_YET); map known names, SKIPPED included, and send null for anything else. Detail: blank -> null; never more than 400 characters (the #277 input caps it; the mapper is a defence and must not split a surrogate pair). The server alone decides placeholder details and answer skills (contract delta 3); the device AnswerFacts (#308) stays the parity rule for the guard.

Job import (contract 4.5, R4): the app only validates scheme https and length 2,048 before sending; the SSRF checks are the server's (apps-backend #111). The app never fetches the URL itself and never logs it. A JOB_IMPORT_FAILED maps to the drawn 'Not a job post' state at the UI (R5), which is W4's.

Truth on skills (contract delta 5): an empty `ordered` list means no change, never an empty skills section. added must stay within userStatedSkills and answer-named skills; TailorResumeUseCase.verifiedSkills remains the device check.

Rate and cost: no client retry of POST /analyses or /job-imports (each run counts: 20 analyses and 20 imports per Asia/Kolkata day); the in-memory analysis cache (8 JDs, SHA-256 of normalised text) keeps the first result per session as contract 4.3 rule 3 requires.

Sign-out/account switch: RemoteJobAnalysisSource.clear() and PendingTailoringIds keep their existing wipe hooks (SignOutCleaner, LocalDataWiper); any new prod cache (job import) holds nothing beyond the call.

issues.title: feat(billing): three packs, the credit ledger and spend-per-tailoring in the prod flavour
issues.tier_note: Payments (billing/ paths compute sensitive) and the issue asks for a security review (money). In-harness sonnet; Reviewer B with a security mandate; the repository has no mutation tool for Kotlin.
issues.base: Stack on #286's branch (W5-N1 -> W5-N2 in one lane, PLAN 5 W5); start after the #286 PR is open. #268 (#305) comes in through revamp/w2-all.
owner_items: #288 (W5-PLAY): application_pack_15 and application_pack_40 do not exist in Play Console yet; the 15 and 40 packs must degrade safely (hidden, never failing the paywall).

apps-backend#55 (voided/refunded purchases) is open: with the 40 pack a buy-then-refund keeps up to 40 credits. Listed in PROGRESS for the owner; the 15/40 products must not go live in Play before it lands. No code change here.

shared_contracts.CreditsRepository_binding: CreditsRepository is bound once in core:data DataModule to the internal OfflineFirstCreditsRepository (Room credit_ledger, refresh() = Unit). A prod implementation needs either (a) a per-flavour binding (move the @Binds out of DataModule into app demo/prod bindings and make the demo class reachable) or (b) a sync seam: OfflineFirstCreditsRepository.refresh() delegates to an injected remote ledger source that the prod flavour binds and demo binds to a no-op. Both touch core/data (outside the issue file list). Scout default: (b), because it keeps the Room flows that #284's Credits screen observes and the D34 wipe paths (DeleteAccountUseCase, DeleteMyDataUseCase clear credit_ledger) unchanged.
shared_contracts.balance_and_spend: #272 calls CreditsRepository.refresh() after sign-in (wallet read); #284 shows balance and ledger; #278 uses TailoringCreditSpend.forSuccess which records a local SPEND. In prod the server writes TAILORING, so the prod record path must not add a second -1 (record() no-op in prod or the sync replaces rows on refresh), and balance comes from wallet.credits, not from summing rows (GET /credits caps at 100 entries).
shared_contracts.PaymentGateway_unlock: PaymentGateway.unlock(applicationId) stays in core:domain for OfflineSampleDataController (demo). In prod it must make no network call (contract 4.12). TailorMyResumeApi.unlock and UnlockResponse/UnlockDto/CreditKind DTOs are removed.

criteria.text: Given GET /packs lists application_pack_5, _15 and _40 and a fake Play client returns ProductDetails for all three, When RemotePaymentGateway.packs() runs, Then three ApplicationPacks come back in server order with credits from the server and name, priceInPaise and currency from Play (no hard-coded rupee price in prod code); and Given Play returns details only for application_pack_5 (#288 not done), Then only the 5 pack comes back and nothing throws; and Given Play returns none, Then an empty list comes back (the paywall's drawn payment-failed path), not a crash.

Given a signed-in uid, When purchase(packId) runs for each of the three packs, Then Play is launched with that product and obfuscatedAccountId = the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the uid (64 characters), and after Play reports PURCHASED the app POSTs {productId, purchaseToken} once and returns Completed with the entitlement from the server wallet; given a packId that GET /packs did not list, Then Play is not launched and the result is Failed.

Given Play reports PENDING, When purchase runs, Then the result is Pending with the pack id in pendingPackIds, nothing is POSTed, and no credit is added; and Given the server answers 409 PURCHASE_PENDING or 502 PLAY_UNAVAILABLE or the network fails, Then the result is Pending, the token is kept, and a bounded background repost (5 tries, 2-32 s) settles it later.

Given the server answers 400 PURCHASE_INVALID or 403 FORBIDDEN, When the purchase settles, Then the result is Failed(PaymentUnconfirmed), the pack leaves pendingPackIds, no credit is shown, and no repost loops; given Play reports a failure, Then Failed(PaymentUnavailable); given the user cancels, Then Cancelled and nothing is shown (R10). The client never grants credits on its own: every credit number comes from a server wallet.

Given queryPurchasesAsync returns three owned tokens (one per pack), When restore runs at app start or on an account change, Then each token is re-POSTed (the server answers 200 for a stored token and grants nothing twice), restore failures are swallowed without a crash, a token from another account (403) is dropped, and after an account switch no repost from the old account continues (generation guard kept).

Given a v2 wallet {credits, freeCredits, purchasedCredits, analysesLeftToday, day, resetsAt} with or without the deprecated freeTailoringsLeftToday and unlockedApplicationIds, When WalletSource decodes it, Then decoding succeeds, the entitlement total equals `credits`, and no app code reads or sends the deprecated fields (contract 1 compatibility table).

Given the prod flavour, When a tailoring, an export or a restore runs in a MockWebServer test, Then no request goes to /applications/{id}/unlock, TailorMyResumeApi has no unlock method, and prod PaymentGateway.unlock returns without a network call.

Given GET /credits returns entries of kinds WELCOME, PURCHASE (+5/+15/+40 with productId), TAILORING (-1 with applicationId), REFUND and MIGRATION, newest first, When the prod CreditsRepository refreshes, Then observeLedger emits them newest first with WELCOME -> FREE_GRANT, PURCHASE -> PURCHASE, TAILORING -> SPEND (D33), REFUND and MIGRATION -> the additive device kinds REFUND and MIGRATION (default, needs_info), signed amounts kept; and Given an entry with an unknown kind, Then that entry is skipped and the rest still emit.

Given the server wallet credits = 6 and a ledger page whose rows sum to something else (capped at 100, or a pre-ledger wallet), When the balance is observed in prod, Then it is 6 (wallet.credits), never the row sum.

Given a successful prod tailoring, When the credit spend is recorded, Then no local SPEND row is added on top of the server's TAILORING row (the balance drops by exactly 1 after refresh); given 402 NO_CREDIT at start or a FAILED/INTERRUPTED job, Then after refresh the balance is unchanged (contract 4.4 credit rules 2 and 4). The demo flavour still records its local SPEND.

Given refresh() fails (offline, 5xx, 429), When the Credits screen observes, Then the last values owned by the current uid stay and nothing is wiped; given sign-out or an account switch, Then the prod wallet and ledger cache are cleared and a late answer for the old account is dropped; Delete account and Delete my data still clear the local ledger (D34).

Given the demo flavour, When it builds and its tests run, Then OfflinePaymentGateway and MockPackCatalogue (D33 prices) are unchanged, the merged demo manifest has no INTERNET permission, and Play Billing is not on the demo runtime classpath (dependencyGuard demo baseline unchanged).

Given app/src/prod/kotlin/**/billing/** and the credits sources, When they are searched, Then no purchase token, order id, uid, obfuscatedAccountId or ID token is logged or put in an exception message.

Given the branch head, When tests with the fake Play client (3 products, pending, failure, restore), `./gradlew dependencyGuard` and `tools/ci/verify-local.sh` run, Then all pass with both baselines unchanged (issue acceptance criteria 1-3).

Calling consumeAsync or acknowledge on the device: the server consumes (contract 4.7).

UsageAllowance as a new interface: analysesLeftToday stays on the wallet/analysis answer; no new domain interface unless a W4 screen needs it.

constraints: Constitution wins every conflict. Settled items (GOAL.md section 1, PRD 6.1.2 'Not in the MVP') are never reopened: no consent screen, no 18+ check, no light theme, Google sign-in only, no follow-up reminders, no offline states, no error states beyond the five drawn ones (sign-in cancelled, unreadable file, not a job post, tailoring failed, payment failed). Undrawn failures map to a drawn state or the drawn toast pattern (PLAN R5, R10).

I.5 / AGENTS.md flavours: candidate data leaves the device only to apps-backend, only in the prod flavour. The demo flavour keeps no INTERNET permission (only app/src/prod/AndroidManifest.xml declares it), its bindings (app/src/demo/kotlin/.../di/*Bindings.kt) and offline sources stay unchanged, and nothing from core:network or Play Billing reaches the demo classpath. Network libraries only in core:network or prodImplementation in :app. One HTTP stack (OkHttp, Retrofit, kotlinx.serialization). The consent precondition in I.5 is struck by #255 (settled list): no consent call.

Contract v2 (docs/BACKEND_CONTRACT.md on PR #293 head revamp/285-contract-v2 00e99f41) is the shape source of truth; read it with `git show origin/revamp/285-contract-v2:docs/BACKEND_CONTRACT.md`. Where the deployed server PRs differ, follow the stricter of the two and record the delta in the PR body under Decisions (see contract_deltas in this file). Never edit docs/BACKEND_CONTRACT.md in this lane; a needed doc change is a follow-up on #285.

Requests: every request keeps X-App-Id and the Firebase bearer through the existing AppIdInterceptor/AuthInterceptor (one forced refresh on 401). Server bodies are strict: an unknown or null-for-optional field is 400 INVALID_INPUT, so tailormyresumeJson() (encodeDefaults = true, explicitNulls default) must not emit keys the server schema lacks. Responses: ignoreUnknownKeys stays on; a new or unknown enum value in a response (failureCode, verification, ledger kind, link kind, editType) must not crash decoding: decode it as nullable/unknown and fail closed (drop the item or treat as a generic failure).

Timeouts and retries: keep the existing OkHttp connect 15 s / read 60 s / call 75 s (contract 2: sync AI routes stop at 45 s on the server, app waits 60 s). No automatic retry of a sync AI call (analyses count every run; ANALYSIS_IN_PROGRESS is shown, not retried). Tailoring start keeps the bounded RATE_LIMITED retry (3 attempts, Retry-After honoured up to 60 s) and polling with backoff (2 s first, max 5 s, give up at 330 s per contract 4.4 rule 5). Background reposts stay bounded (5 tries, 2-32 s). No unbounded loop.

Privacy: never log a request or response body, resume text, JD text, job URL, fact, answer detail, purchase token, order id, uid or ID token (contract 2, 4.5 rule 4). No OkHttp logging interceptor, no Log/Timber/println in core/network or app/src/prod.

Truth (I.1): the on-device FabricationGuard via TailorResumeUseCase stays the last gate after the server checks (contract D7). The prod path must not bypass or loosen it; I.1 gate tests OfflineFabricationGuardTest and TailorResumeUseCaseTest keep every assertion. When the device cannot resolve a cited id it fails closed (the original text stays). Answer facts: only the server issues ans- ids; the app never sends USER_ANSWER entries or ans- ids (sendableFacts already filters them; keep the test).

II.6: each AI step stays behind its core:domain interface with a Hilt binding per flavour; core:network depends only on core:model (no core:domain import there); prod mapping from DTO to domain lives in app/src/prod or core:network mappers to core:model types.

IV.2/IV.3: fakes only (FakePlayBilling, FixedIds, MockWebServer); no mocking library; runTest and virtual time, no Thread.sleep. MockWebServer and Robolectric are already testProdImplementation / core:network testImplementation, so no new dependency; dependencyGuard baselines (app/dependencies/demoReleaseRuntimeClasspath.txt, prodReleaseRuntimeClasspath.txt) stay unchanged (PLAN 6.4).

Process rules: never git stash (shared stash stack across lane worktrees); worktree with `git worktree add -b <branch> <path> <base>`; no tools:ignore, no lint-baseline entries (III.3), no weakened tests; no code comments unless they pass the grounding test in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (III.2: cite the contract section line); one bounded wait per Gradle run; never ./gradlew --stop while other lanes run; host load rule D22/D35 (2 lanes when load is over about 12); stage paths explicitly (no git add -A).

Staging: backend PRs apps-backend #101-#111 are open, not deployed (merges blocked, #256). Tests run against MockWebServer only; no call to the Fly.io app from tests. A live check belongs to Phase 3 after deploy.

Play Billing test purchases only: unit tests use FakePlayBilling; any device check uses licence testers or test cards on the closed track; never a real purchase, never a live key. No consumeAsync on the device (the server consumes, contract 4.7 step 6).

Safe degrade for #288: a pack with no Play ProductDetails is hidden (mapNotNull, keep it); never show a price that did not come from Play; never launch a purchase for a product Play did not return. GooglePlayBilling queries one product per call today; keep it or batch, but a missing product must not fail the other two.

Money: the client never grants credits; every credit value comes from GET /wallet, the purchase answer's wallet, or GET /credits. obfuscatedAccountId stays the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the Firebase uid (ObfuscatedAccountIdTest unchanged). A purchase token stays until the server confirms (Pending), so a lost connection never loses a paid purchase.

apps-backend#55 refunds are open: the client must not show refunds it does not get; REFUND rows appear only when the server writes them. Owner gate: 15/40 products go live in Play only after #55 (PROGRESS owner list).

Ledger mapping default (needs_info, lead): add REFUND and MIGRATION to core:model CreditLedgerKind (additive; Room stores the name as TEXT, no migration, no schema bump; V.6 unaffected). Labels for them are #284's (copy is a lead choice). The demo never writes them.

CreditsRepository default (shared_contracts): keep the core:data binding and add a remote ledger seam that prod binds; files core/data/src/main/**/repository/{CreditsRepository,OfflineFirstCreditsRepository}.kt and DataModule.kt are extras to record in the PR. Balance in prod = wallet.credits. The Room ledger in prod is a cache that a refresh replaces, owned by the current uid; Delete account/Delete my data keep clearing it (D34).

Spend per tailoring: no unlock route (contract 4.12, D7). The device SPEND write (TailoringCreditSpend) must not double-count in prod: prod record() is a no-op followed by refresh(), or refresh replaces rows. Decide once in this lane; #278 calls TailoringCreditSpend and must not care which flavour runs.

Wallet DTO: drop freeTailoringsLeftToday and unlockedApplicationIds from WalletDto (ignoreUnknownKeys keeps v1 answers decodable); PurchaseEntitlement.unlockedApplicationIds stays empty in prod (field kept in core:domain for the demo and the archive until a follow-up).
Session/account switch: keep the generation and uid guards of WalletSource and RemotePaymentGateway; the new ledger cache gets the same guard (late answers for another uid are dropped).
state: prod server wallet + credit ledger cache keyed by uid (GET /wallet, GET /credits; Room credit_ledger only as a refresh-replaced mirror under the default seam)
